facts.label: Quote process
facts.text: The General asks about personal information, driving history, SR-22 status and the vehicle when preparing a quote. A quote can be saved for comparison.

facts.label: Proof of insurance
facts.text: The described online process provides printable proof after the down payment and electronic application signature. Confirm the actual policy effective date.

facts.label: Household drivers
facts.text: The General says household residents age 14 and older in most states, and other regular drivers, must be listed or excluded. Review the rules for your state before buying.
